# Apply Step 5: Seal

Run xirang quality seal <change-name> using the generated Seal schema. Seal requires a passing latest full-change Review, no failing latest Review for any reviewKind, an explicit Opt disposition and your positive canRun/testsExpectedToPass declarations for an existing Git commit. After a change-producing Opt, Seal additionally requires a later full-change/incremental PASS: its recordedRevision must exceed the last changed delivery, its commit must equal the result or be a Git descendant, and Seal must bind that reviewed commit. Supplemental alone does not cover cumulative optimization. Keep unresolved FAIL gates. Only Quality record commits advancing HEAD do not change the evaluated implementation commit. Seal does not run tests or compare the commit with HEAD/workspace.

After Seal succeeds, Archive may run its independent gates. Do not separately commit Quality JSON before Seal or Archive; include it in the normal Git handoff. A rejected payload or revision conflict requires reading status and reconciling before retry.
